appId: com.pbordjadze.paintbynumber

    start: '60%,18%'
    end: '58%,25%'

- swipe:
    start: '58%,25%'

- waitForAnimationToEnd
- takeScreenshot: /Users/runner/work/paint-by-number/paint-by-number/out/shots/r06-drawn
- tapOn:
    point: '97%,4%'
- waitForAnimationToEnd
- tapOn: 'Back'
- waitForAnimationToEnd
- takeScreenshot: /Users/runner/work/paint-by-number/paint-by-number/out/shots/r07-gallery
- tapOn:
    point: '72%,4%'
- waitForAnimationToEnd
- takeScreenshot: /Users/runner/work/paint-by-number/paint-by-number/out/shots/r08-paint-page
- tapOn:
    point: '3%,4%'
- waitForAnimationToEnd
- tapOn:
    point: '3%,4%'
- waitForAnimationToEnd
- scrollUntilVisible:
